mapper.select: select COUNT(*) FREQUENCY, DATE_FORMAT(ssp.CREATION_DATE, '%Y') BYEAR, ssoi.CATEGORY_ID FROM scc_sou_order_item ssoi inner join scc_sou_item ssi on ssi.SOU_ITEM_ID = ssoi.SOU_ITEM_ID inner join scc_sou_vendor ssv on ssv.PROJECT_ID = ssoi.PROJECT_ID and ssv.VENDOR_ID = ssoi.VENDOR_ID inner join scc_sou_project ssp on ssoi.PROJECT_ID = ssp.PROJECT_ID -- 已定价 where ssp.PROJECT_STATUS = 'PRICE_END' -- 审批状态已审批 and ssp.CREATE_APPROVAL_STATUS = 'APPROVED' -- 已中标 and ssoi.SELECT_STATUS = 'WIN' and TO_CHAR(ssp.CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY') >= TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(sysdate, -24), 'YYYY') and ssoi.CATEGORY_ID = #{categoryId} and ssoi.VENDOR_ID = #{vendorId} group by 'BYEAR', ssoi.CATEGORY_ID order by 'BYEAR'
